exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Passive and Potential Forms".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb られる (〜rareru) matches "Passive and Potential Forms".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb られる (〜rareru).
exercises.explanation: Expresses passive voice or ability (can do) with verbs using られる.
